lede: LSU carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.6 against +3.6, a 4.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Kentucky +5.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with LSU winning 64% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Kentucky leads LSU by 98 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
